generation_prompt: The robot closes its right fingers and thumb around the translucent reddish-orange glass on the pink plate, lifts it clear, and carries it to the pale turquoise plate. It lowers the glass until its base rests on the turquoise plate, then opens its right hand beside the glass. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The pink plate is empty. The glass base rests within the pale turquoise plate and the right hand is open immediately beside the glass; no later withdrawal or extended settling interval is shown. The left hand is still open above the blue plate.

arm_hand_roles.right: Active manipulation: reaches, surrounds the glass with dexterous fingers and opposed thumb, grasps, lifts, carries to the turquoise plate, lowers and opens beside it.
arm_hand_roles.left: Idle open hand above the blue plate throughout; no grasp, stabilization or hand-to-hand transfer.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: The task is performed by the right hand alone. The two hands do not contact one another or jointly support the object.

uncertainties: The right hand remains very close to the glass at the final frame; complete clearance at every finger and subsequent unassisted stability are not visible. The prompt describes the observed hand opening without claiming a later withdrawal or settled state.
annotation_discrepancies: The instruction calls the object orange; the observed translucent glass appears reddish-orange/red under the lighting. The right-hand transfer and turquoise destination agree with the annotation.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
